tied_response: At each threshold evaluate the same spectral rule on the actual canonically normalized parent left up/down lines. At the weak pole identify the right down projector with the lepton doublet by the physical 10 PeV GJ tags; both still-active raw Yukawa columns and both effective Majorana sources are transformed. At the color pole compute the color contraction on the current quark lines. A common stored weak-pole gain may be compared to the local gain; the difference is reported.
